text: Well, it's another week, and JeE-DeY's squad is still clinging to the top spot, though the Do vs. Do rivalry is tighter than a checking board at the buzzer with LMD right on his heels and Super Mario nipping at their skates. Hot Dog and Deagle's Team are the biggest climbers, each inching up a spot thanks to some solid performances, while The Camaraderie took a tumble, proving even brotherhood can't always outmuscle fantasy points. Keep an eye on Mattress Dobes, Tristan, because if you don't start heating up soon, you might just be stuck on the bargain rack next week.
